observation_1_title: Your ad doesn't say where you work or how fast you come
observation_1: The headlines we saw were "Quality Plumbing Services" and "Call Today". Neither mentions Tampa, same-day service or your Google reviews, which are what people compare when three plumbers show up on one screen.
observation_1_short: the ad doesn't mention Tampa, same-day service or your reviews
observation_1_check: Which headlines Google shows most often, and whether location and review assets are switched on.
observation_2_title: The ad sends people to your homepage
observation_2: The ad's link goes to your homepage, where water heaters are one of many services in the menu. Someone with a leaking tank has to hunt for the right page before they call.
observation_2_short: the ad goes to your homepage, not a water-heater page
observation_2_check: How calls and forms from that ad compare with your other services, and whether a dedicated page is worth testing.
observation_3_title: On a phone, the call button is hard to find
observation_3: On a phone, the first tap-to-call button sits at the bottom of the page, under the reviews. Google's PageSpeed test also rated the page slow to load on mobile.
observation_3_check: Whether calls from the ad are counted as conversions, and how mobile and desktop leads compare.
